capabilities.name: Acquisition and Manifest Ingestion
capabilities.evidence: Imported 5 real academic manifests via kad-knowledge research import; validated path confinement and schema validation.

capabilities.name: Canonical Normalized Representation
capabilities.evidence: All DOIs and arXiv identifiers normalized deterministically into canonical ResearchDocument representations.

capabilities.name: Provenance and Epistemic Tracking
capabilities.evidence: Provenance actor, method, timestamps, and SHA-256 byte hashes retained and verified across persistence.

capabilities.name: Idempotency and Conflict Detection
capabilities.evidence: Re-importing existing manifest yielded IDEMPOTENT_EXISTING without duplicate creation or canonical corruption.

capabilities.name: Deterministic Document Retrieval
capabilities.evidence: Retrieved documents by exact canonical ID, DOI, and year filter via kad-knowledge research inspect/list.

capabilities.name: Evidence Extraction
capabilities.evidence: Extracted exact empirical excerpts, benchmark scores, and architecture mechanisms from local source files.

capabilities.name: Citation Traceability
capabilities.evidence: Mapped all synthesis claims to canonical identifiers (arXiv:2210.03629, arXiv:2310.06770, arXiv:2302.04761, arXiv:2303.11366, arXiv:2303.17651).

capabilities.name: Evidence-Grounded Synthesis
capabilities.evidence: Produced structured synthesis with strict epistemic tagging (SOURCE_FACT vs DERIVED_SYNTHESIS vs PROJECT_INFERENCE vs UNKNOWN).

capabilities.name: Context Handoff & Knowledge Plane Integration
capabilities.evidence: Research catalog integrates with Librarian and KAD knowledge plane without LLM context pollution.

capabilities.name: Graceful Degradation & Free/Manual Fallback
capabilities.evidence: Fully operational with Zotero unconfigured, OpenViking offline, and zero paid API spend.
